summary: The screen of a GRUB disk that SeaBIOS boots, on a framebuffer by default and in the VGA's text mode from the menu's text entry, with Doom on each: two boots of one disk under tests/cases/machine/seabios_scenario.c

cases.behavior: SeaBIOS boots the GRUB disk on the framebuffer of the mode the video BIOS prefers, whose size the kernel names, with the login prompt on it in the kernel's font, Doom's picture scaled onto the whole framebuffer and the console back once the game is killed; with the menu's text entry armed for one boot, GRUB consumes the trial and leaves the kernel the VGA's text mode of 80 by 25 cells, where Doom draws in mode 13h and the text mode comes back once the game is killed

inputs.disk: the menu case's GRUB disk on an MBR with os-real's ext2 root of 96 MiB, which stages the Doom WAD
inputs.armed: next_entry=text written into the copy's GRUB environment block

execution.cleanup: libetude-case ends the machine and removes the disk's copy, which it keeps after a failure; the scenario removes the screen dumps after a pass

steps.does: boot the disk through SeaBIOS and GRUB's default entry, log in as root at the serial console, look for the WAD, dump the screen through QMP and read it with screentext, run the game in the background until it reports its first frame, dump the screen, kill the game, wait until it has gone, dump the screen again and power off

write next_entry=text into the copy's environment block, boot it, log in as root, read next_entry with bootctl env, dump the screen, run the game until its first frame, dump the screen, kill the game, dump the screen again and end the machine with QMP's quit

assertions.checks: the kernel's record boot: screen: framebuffer, rgb names a framebuffer of at least 640x384, the mode GRUB set for the default entry
the disk has /demo/doom1.wad, which its root stages from ports/doom/doom1.wad
the screen dump has the size of the framebuffer the kernel named
a line of the framebuffer console's text, as screentext reads the dump against the kernel's font, begins rach2 login:
the screen dumped once the game has reported its first frame has the framebuffer's size and more than 64 colors, so the game's picture is scaled onto the framebuffer
the screen dumped once the game has gone has the framebuffer's size, at most the console's 16 colors and a line that begins rach2 login:
the copy of the disk has GRUB's environment block, and next_entry=text is written into it
the kernel's record says boot: screen: text, 80x25 cells, the mode the text entry leaves
bootctl env next_entry says the key is empty, so the menu consumed the trial of the text entry
the screen dump is 720x400 or 640x400, the VGA's 80 by 25 cells, with 2 to 16 colors
the screen dumped once the game has reported its first frame is mode 13h's 320x200 with more than 64 colors
the screen dumped once the game has gone is the text mode's again, with 2 to 16 colors

progress.means: a step of the manifest has ended

native.reason: the case boots a disk the firmware starts, arms a menu entry in its copy from the host and dumps the screen through QMP, which only QEMU's firmware and monitor give
